site.sitedescription: Closed basin mire located in sandy outwash along the margin of the Monk's Hill recessional moraine. Surrounding vegetation: Quercus, Pinus strobus, Betula, Acer rubrum, Tsuga canadensis, and Fagus grandifolia. Grass with cedar immediately at site.
